feeds.title: SA Financial Marketing Journal » Instruments & Investments
feeds.description: The SA Financial Market Journal is the official financial market journal of the South African Institute of Financial Markets and serves as a platform where financial regulation practitioners can share their knowledge. The importance of financial regulation has accelerated over the decade since the financial crisis and it has become necessary to provide a platform where knowledge and understanding can be shared between regulators, financial markets practitioners and financial regulation practitioners.

feeds.title: Amity Investment Solutions Blog

Their outcomes-based investment solutions enable and equip professional investment advisors to provide an integrated life-centred wealth management value proposition to their clients.

feeds.title: Invest In Yourself Blog

Their team is made up of professional financial wellness coaches in private practice.
